title: Import plugin
body: Add a plugin from a .zip or a bundle .json file. You review what it contains before anything is installed, and it arrives disabled.

zone.label: Plugin file drop zone
zone.prompt: Drop a .zip or .json plugin file here

problem.tooLarge: This file is larger than {max} MB. Choose a smaller plugin file.
problem.issuesHeading: What is wrong with the file

preview.title: Review plugin
preview.counts: {agents, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} · {skills, plural, one {# skill} other {# skills}} · {evalCases, plural, one {# eval case} other {# eval cases}} · {learnings, plural, one {# learning} other {# learnings}}
preview.conventionsNotInstalled: {count, plural, one {# convention is} other {# conventions are}} in the file but never installed.
preview.conflictPlugin: A plugin named {name} is already installed.
preview.conflictHelp: Remove the existing item or change the name in the file, then choose the file again.

installed.title: Plugin installed
installed.created: {agents, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} · {skills, plural, one {# skill} other {# skills}} · {evalCases, plural, one {# eval case} other {# eval cases}} · {learnings, plural, one {# learning} other {# learnings}} added.
